
== Signing Up ==

If you don't have a user name, just [[jbocre: iki-register.php egister|iki-register.php egister]].  There is no approval process.

== Logging In ==

You can log in to your account at [[jbocre: iki-login_scr.php he login screen]].  Please note that that link is repeated no-where else on this site; you probably should bookmark it if you're going to be editing pages often!
